summary: No installer-harm behavior observed in veldora@1.0.1
details: Package veldora@1.0.1 was scanned across 6 files. No evidence of install-time or import-time execution of remote content, no credential or environment variable collection, no hardcoded attacker-controlled network destinations, no lifecycle scripts fetching external payloads, and no obfuscated code paths were observed. The package does not exhibit any of the standard supply-chain attack fingerprints (exfiltration, dropper, silent-relay, backdoor, self-propagation, credential distribution).
